test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Change hands

options.text: Give away something you do not need
Pass from one person to another
Move from one hand to another

solution:
The correct answer is "**Pass from one person to another**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The meaning of the idiom 'change hands' is **passed to another person in the course of a business transaction**.
 
• We use this idiom when referring to an object or property that has passed from one owner to another in a deal.
 
 
• **Example**: *The quality of customer service deteriorated as the company **changed hands.***
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2**.
